name: 趋势回撤 · 每日五选

formula.stability: cross-sectional percentile of negative 60-session daily-return population standard deviation
formula.pullback: cross-sectional percentile of negative 5-session close return
formula.eligibility: Shanghai/Shenzhen main board; current dated non-ST name; 250 bars; >=365 calendar days listed; positive OHLC/volume/amount; close >=3; 20-session average amount >=100m CNY; close > MA120; positive trend
formula.market_gate: fraction of complete main-board stocks above MA120 >=40%; otherwise zero new picks
formula.missing: exclude incomplete stocks; never redistribute scoring weights
formula.industry: at most one per known industry; all unknown industries share one bucket

execution.entry: first market session after the frozen signal, open; do not buy at an open >=9.5% above prior close or without valid trading volume
execution.exit: 20th session including entry, close; defer exits without trading volume or at a close <=-9.5% of prior close
execution.unfilled: one entry attempt; unfilled allocation stays cash; no replacement using future data
execution.adjustment: signals use qfq history; execution uses dated unadjusted quote snapshots; prior-close discontinuity >0.5% marks corporate-action review and prevents acceptance until resolved; dividends are not credited
execution.pool_control: same signal-day eligible pool, equal allocations, fractional units, same cost bps; excludes minimum-order fee and lots, explicitly approximate
execution.cohorts: each daily signal is an independent 100000 CNY cohort; daily cohorts overlap and must never be compounded as one portfolio

acceptance.primary_metric: mean matured 20-session net cohort return minus same-period index open-to-close return >0
acceptance.secondary_metric: mean matured net return minus same-pool approximate control >0
acceptance.meaning: observation threshold only, not statistical proof; overlapping cohorts are dependent; disclose losses, fill failures, pending exits and missing benchmarks
